title: A surety must bear the owed penalty
source_text: V. Ut igitur Dei misericordia erga homines sese exereret, & tamen justitiae etiam suus esset locus, oportuit vadem aliquem & sponsorem intervenire, in quem poena hominibus debita derivaretur.
pass_a_gloss: So that God’s mercy toward men might exert itself, and yet justice also have its place, it was necessary that some surety and sponsor intervene, onto whom the penalty due to men would be transferred.
pass_b_english: Mercy and justice both require a surety onto whom men’s due penalty is transferred.
